WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    ReportsTo,
    COUNT(*) as employee_count
  FROM Employee
  GROUP BY ReportsTo
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(employee_count) as total_count,
    COUNT(*) as num_groups
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT 
  g.ReportsTo,
  g.employee_count,
  CAST(g.employee_count AS FLOAT) / s.total_count as share,
  CAST(g.employee_count AS FLOAT) / s.total_count - CAST(1.0 AS FLOAT) / s.num_groups as diff_from_avg
FROM grouped g
CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
